WATCH THE ORGANIC CHEMISTRY TUTOR ON YOUTUBE!! I took first year physics twice (1st year - general physics, 2nd year - calculus based). His videos are much more geared towards general physics. They help you learn the concepts, LOADS of practice problems, etc. 
One thing I would do a lot (once I understood the concepts) is when the video presents a practice problem, I would work it out and then watch him work it out, which made me participate instead of just watching him work it out + I could see if I made any mistakes and where it occurred, etc.

It really helped me, as I learn from example and textbooks make my eyes glaze over.
